dialogue_turns.text: [reading off her phone, fast, thrilled] The fixtures are out! I've picked three weekends.
[flat, to her] They came out four minutes ago.
[sunny, to the camera] Four good minutes.
[to the camera, after a beat] They'll move every one of those games.

payload.scene: A phone vlog on the forecourt of a stadium at dusk, ten minutes before the game: a queue at the turnstiles behind, floodlights coming on.
payload.sample_context: A ten-second comedy moment played by two close friends on a sports trip. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful, quick and sure of herself; to her everything is good news. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he never raises his voice. They answer each other fast.

text: The fixtures are out, I've picked three weekends. They came out four minutes ago. Four good minutes. They'll move every one of those games.
